name: Justice Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public justice and criminal-justice data.

entries.title: Federal Judicial Center Integrated Database (IDB)
entries.description: Case-level data on civil case and criminal defendant filings and terminations in the U.S. district courts, plus bankruptcy and appellate court cases, maintained by the Federal Judicial Center with the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts.

coverage.spatial: United States (federal district, bankruptcy, and appellate courts)

entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page says the FJC, "under a working arrangement with the Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts (AOUSC)", provides public access to the IDB, which holds civil and criminal district-court filings and terminations plus bankruptcy and appellate case information "from 1970 to the present". Download formats and the update cadence weren't checked; cadence is recorded as irregular until a steward confirms it.

entries.title: UNODC Data Portal
entries.description: The UN Office on Drugs and Crime's statistical portal covering intentional homicide, trafficking, prison populations, corruption, and access-to-justice indicators across UN member states.
entries.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200, redirects to data.unodc.org). Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
